body.name: Exact full-set coverage repair
body.construction: If \(\widetilde K\) has global coverage at least \(1-\eta-\rho\), define \(\operatorname{Repair}_{\eta,\rho}(\widetilde K)\) to report \(V\) with probability \(\rho/(\eta+\rho)\) and otherwise draw from \(\widetilde K\).
inputs: a rule with a certified coverage deficit \(\rho\)
